(3) e.8.1.8 (A:823-1604) is the Prp8 RT domain, in the DNA/RNA polymerase superfamily e.8.1, a superfamily-level relation to reverse transcriptase/polymerase folds. Strength differs by level: family membership (bromodomain) implies the closest shared ancestry; superfamily membership (e.8.1, c.52.1, c.55.3) implies a shared structural core that may have diverged far beyond detectable sequence identity; fold membership alone does not establish common ancestry; the Prp8-only family nodes (c.55.3.14, c.52.1.36, e.8.1.8) show SCOPe places these segments only with Prp8 at family level. Limits: SCOPe classification is structural and does not transfer function. The absence of other d.394 members is a release-specific negative (release 2.08 stable label; I did not query the 2026-08-16 periodic update), not proof that no homolog exists. The 'automated matches' child nodes under the RT and bromodomain families are automated grouping nodes, not curated, independently characterized proteins.
